source: RFC 0006 §5.3.2, usability review UA-1 and UA-2
statement: Whether a revoked token, or a role removed from a user, still counts is never a default argument: no public constructor or function of a published module defaults a RevocationReader, a TokenRevocation or a MembershipRefresh. RevocationReader.NONE and MembershipRefresh.CLAIMS stay available, written by whoever chooses them.
guards: architecture:SafeDefaultsTest#no public parameter that reads revocations or memberships has a default
architecture:SafeDefaultsTest#the scan reads the token API
